// Toward WCAG AAA, as accessibility teams customize Bootstrap: 7:1 text, 2px
// borders that stand out at 3:1, a 4px focus ring in the text color with an
// offset, solid disabled controls and no translucent borders. Every theme
// color gets darker text and fills, so white on a fill and colored text on
// the page both reach 7:1. Theme maps replace whole sub-maps: a theme passed
// here keeps none of the default's keys.

@use "bootstrap/scss/bootstrap" with (
  $border-width: 2px,

  $root-tokens: (
    --border-color: light-dark(var(--gray-600), var(--gray-400)),
    --border-color-translucent: var(--border-color),
    --link-color: var(--primary-fg),
    --link-hover-color: var(--primary-fg-emphasis),
    --code-color: var(--fg-1),
    --focus-ring-width: 4px,
    --focus-ring-offset: 2px,
    --focus-ring-color: var(--fg-body),
    --control-disabled-bg: var(--bg-3),
    --control-disabled-opacity: 1,
  ),

  $theme-colors: (
    "primary": (
      "base": var(--blue-700),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--blue-800), var(--blue-300)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--blue-900), var(--blue-200)),
      "bg": var(--blue-700),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--blue-050), var(--blue-950)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--blue-100), var(--blue-900)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--blue-700), var(--blue-300)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": var(--white)
    ),
    "accent": (
      "base": var(--indigo-700),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--indigo-800), var(--indigo-300)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--indigo-900), var(--indigo-200)),
      "bg": var(--indigo-700),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--indigo-050), var(--indigo-950)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--indigo-100), var(--indigo-900)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--indigo-700), var(--indigo-300)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": var(--white)
    ),
    "success": (
      "base": var(--green-800),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--green-800), var(--green-300)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--green-900), var(--green-200)),
      "bg": var(--green-800),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--green-050), var(--green-950)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--green-100), var(--green-900)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--green-700), var(--green-300)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": var(--white)
    ),
    "danger": (
      "base": var(--red-700),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--red-800), var(--red-300)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--red-900), var(--red-200)),
      "bg": var(--red-700),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--red-050), var(--red-950)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--red-100), var(--red-900)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--red-700), var(--red-300)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": var(--white)
    ),
    "warning": (
      "base": var(--yellow-400),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--yellow-800), var(--yellow-300)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--yellow-900), var(--yellow-200)),
      "bg": var(--yellow-400),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--yellow-050), var(--yellow-950)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--yellow-100), var(--yellow-900)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--yellow-700), var(--yellow-300)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": var(--black)
    ),
    "info": (
      "base": var(--cyan-400),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--cyan-800), var(--cyan-300)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--cyan-900), var(--cyan-200)),
      "bg": var(--cyan-400),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--cyan-050), var(--cyan-950)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--cyan-100), var(--cyan-900)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--cyan-700), var(--cyan-300)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": var(--black)
    ),
    "inverse": (
      "base": var(--gray-975),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--black), var(--white)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--black), var(--white)),
      "bg": light-dark(var(--gray-975), var(--gray-025)),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--gray-100), var(--gray-900)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--gray-200), var(--gray-800)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--gray-900), var(--gray-100)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": light-dark(var(--white), var(--black))
    ),
    "secondary": (
      "base": var(--gray-700),
      "fg": light-dark(var(--gray-800), var(--gray-200)),
      "fg-emphasis": light-dark(var(--gray-900), var(--gray-100)),
      "bg": light-dark(var(--gray-100), var(--gray-800)),
      "bg-subtle": light-dark(var(--gray-050), var(--gray-950)),
      "bg-muted": light-dark(var(--gray-100), var(--gray-900)),
      "border": light-dark(var(--gray-700), var(--gray-300)),
      "focus-ring": var(--fg-body),
      "contrast": light-dark(var(--black), var(--white))
    )
  ),

  $theme-bgs: (
    "body": light-dark(var(--white), var(--black)),
    "1": light-dark(var(--gray-025), var(--gray-975)),
    "2": light-dark(var(--gray-050), var(--gray-950)),
    "3": light-dark(var(--gray-100), var(--gray-900)),
    "4": light-dark(var(--gray-200), var(--gray-800)),
  ),

  $theme-fgs: (
    "body": light-dark(var(--black), var(--white)),
    "1": light-dark(var(--gray-975), var(--gray-025)),
    "2": light-dark(var(--gray-900), var(--gray-050)),
    "3": light-dark(var(--gray-800), var(--gray-100)),
    "4": light-dark(var(--gray-700), var(--gray-200)),
  ),

  $theme-borders: (
    "body": light-dark(var(--gray-600), var(--gray-400)),
    "muted": light-dark(var(--gray-600), var(--gray-400)),
    "subtle": light-dark(var(--gray-600), var(--gray-400)),
    "emphasized": light-dark(var(--gray-800), var(--gray-200)),
  ),

  // Translucency the global tokens don't reach, component by component.
  // Switches, chips, the combobox toggle, menu item descriptions and the
  // datepicker hard-code theirs (#208, #209).
  $button-tokens: (
    --btn-disabled-opacity: 1,
  ),
  $btn-close-tokens: (
    --btn-close-opacity: 1,
    --btn-close-hover-opacity: 1,
    --btn-close-focus-opacity: 1,
  ),
  $chip-tokens: (
    --chip-dismiss-opacity: 1,
  ),
  $tooltip-tokens: (
    --tooltip-opacity: 1,
  ),
  // A percentage: the default `.65` isn't valid in `color-mix()`, so it's
  // ignored (#210).
  $form-floating-tokens: (
    --form-floating-label-opacity: 100%,
  ),
  $navbar-dark-tokens: (
    --navbar-color: var(--white),
    --navbar-hover-color: var(--white),
    --navbar-disabled-color: var(--gray-400),
    --navbar-toggler-border-color: var(--white),
  )
);

// Your own Sass, with access to Bootstrap's mixins and functions.
@use "custom";

files.README.md:
# pg-209: Issue reproduction

Disabled switches, chips and the combobox toggle keep a translucent opacity when --control-disabled-opacity is 1.

Bootstrap main at 2f63a73 (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/commit/2f63a737635d9c8daea42bb5509f4fe81c0e6789), compiled from its source with this reproduction's config: `main.scss` (Sass options), `_custom.scss` (Sass rules) and `tokens.css` (CSS custom properties and rules).

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

Exported from https://github.com/julien-deramond/bootstrap-test-playground/tree/main/issues/pg-209
